Hi all —

Following up from our intake forms, it looks like three of you expressed interest in a short technical sprint-style cohort session to walk through latency/cost tradeoffs, model variants, and quick integration patterns for Redwood Dedicated/hosted flows. We propose a 60-minute group session: 30m demo + 30m focused Q&A and configuration triage.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu May 27, 08:00–09:00 PT
- Thu May 27, 16:00–17:00 PT

Please reply with your preferred slot(s) and any constraints. If none of these work, share a couple alternatives and we’ll coordinate. I’ve attached a short deck that covers the agenda and pre-reqs.

Agenda highlights:
- Quick architecture overview (10m)
- Demo: routing, batching, and cost controls (20m)
- Q&A and next steps: test accounts, benchmarks, and onboarding plan (30m)

Attendees we plan to bring from Redwood: Camila (solutions engineer) and Aditya (sales engineer).

Attachments: redwood-cohort-onboarding-deck-v2.pdf (6 slides), cohort-demo-invite.ics (placeholder calendar invite)
